implementation_summary.prepare_commit_split: run_forecast() now accepts _defer_registration=True. When True, it skips the register_publication() call. The CLI (revenue_forecast.py) uses this to: (1) prepare, (2) write members, (3) commit via commit_publication().
implementation_summary.commit_publication_api: New function in publication_registry.py: takes result + member_paths, verifies members exist and computes hashes, computes publication_id, checks idempotency, then does the single registry append.
implementation_summary.commit_status_reader: New function in publication_registry.py: checks if a publication_id has a committed row with all members verified. Returns status, entry, member_verification, and problems.
implementation_summary.new_registry_fields: publication_id, state, members, member_sha256, attempt_seq, supersedes — all additive (old rows stay readable).
implementation_summary.stdout_only_rejection: CLI now rejects formal mode without --output (I09-E08: no persistent members).
implementation_summary.open_i09a_4: The directory-valued registry check was NOT implemented as a hard rejection (would break the conftest.py test pattern). Instead, documented as a test showing that nested-file corruption is detected by the chain hash.
